subject: Important Updates on Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, we wanted to inform you about some recent changes to your account settings. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance security, we have implemented a new two-factor authentication process. Starting next week, you will be required to verify your identity using this additional step when logging in to your account. We appreciate your cooperation in helping us maintain the privacy and security of your information. Should you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to our customer support team.
